title: Upwork proposals

agent.name: Sana
agent.instructions: Never claim experience I don't have.

memories.content: Data analyst with Python, SQL and Power BI
3 years of experience in retail analytics

topics.ask: Draft a proposal for a job: 'Build a Power BI sales dashboard from our SQL Server data, 2 weeks'.
topics.answer: Hi, I build Power BI dashboards on top of SQL databases and have spent 3 years in retail analytics, so sales reporting is familiar ground. For your project I'd start with a 30-minute call to agree the five numbers you look at every week, then model the data in Power BI, build the report pages and set up scheduled refresh. Two weeks works: days 1–3 data model, days 4–8 report pages, days 9–10 testing with your team. Could you share which SQL Server version you use and how many users need access?

topics.ask: They asked about my past work but I can't share client dashboards.
topics.answer: Say that plainly and offer something you can show: a dashboard you build on a public sample dataset, or screenshots with all client data removed and approved. Offer a short screen-share walkthrough of how you'd structure their report. Don't describe client work in a way that identifies the client.

Quote the two-week scope as a fixed price based on your normal rate for 10 working days, state what's included (data model, up to 5 report pages, refresh setup, one round of changes), and what's extra. Ask for 30% upfront through the platform's milestone feature.

ask: Recap the proposal, the portfolio answer and pricing for this client.
